pred_texts: Instruct: Get a medium sized pan and add around three tablespoons of olive oil to the pan.
Feedback: You are using a teaspoon to measure the olive oil, but the recipe requires three tablespoons. This will result in using significantly less oil than intended.

Instruct: Now turn on the heat to medium.
Instruct: Take two medium sized shallots and dice them into small pieces.
Instruct: Now very carefully add the shallots to the hot oil.
Instruct: Now take a spoon and keep stirring the shallots in the pan until they are soft to prevent burning. About  3 minutes.
Instruct: Now take around one cup of tomato sauce and add it to the pan with the shallots.
Instruct: Now stir the tomato and the shallots in the pan together.
Instruct: Now keep the pan at medium heat for about one minute and let it simmer.
